messages:
alex: Kicking off canary rollout to prod for service `inference-runtime` — 10% traffic. Tag: `release/kv-cache-v2` commit: `f2a9c3b`. Change window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Ping @tariq to watch.

deploy-bot: canary-start | service=inference-runtime env=prod canary=10% tag=release/kv-cache-v2 commit=f2a9c3b started_by=alex

nina: :eyes: watching dashboards, will call out any spikes.

oncall-bot: alert: 5xx rate in prod-us-east-1 increased from 0.2% -> 0.9% over last 5m

tariq: seeing the spike in traces, lots of errors around KV cache warmup / misses. Pulling logs now.

alex: Hold promotion. Can we pin traffic back to `release/kv-cache-v1` on affected host group (pool-a) while we investigate? @deploy-bot can you pin 10% for `pool-a`?

deploy-bot: manual-action-required: rollback/pinning not automatic for partial pools. Suggested command:

```
# pin pool-a to previous tag
deployctl pin --service inference-runtime --pool pool-a --tag release/kv-cache-v1
```
Run when ready.

tariq: I'll run the pin now.

tariq: pinned pool-a -> release/kv-cache-v1. Confirmed: `deployctl status --pool pool-a` shows tag=release/kv-cache-v1 :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: alert: 5xx rate decreasing to 0.25% in pool-a, overall prod now 0.48%

nina: Metrics look more stable but latency on remaining canary hosts is up ~6%. Recommend extending canary +30m to get more samples before we promote.

alex: Extension approved. @deploy-bot extend canary 30m. No promotion until extension ends.

deploy-bot: canary-extended | service=inference-runtime extend=30m initiated_by=alex new_end_ts=1755003434

tariq: Found a small fix (buffer sizing) we can apply quickly — I can build a patched commit `f2a9c3b-1` and deploy to canary.

nina: +1 on patched build. Deploy only to canary hosts (exclude pinned pool-a) and monitor.

alex: Go ahead. Deploy patched commit to canary-only, tag `release/kv-cache-v2-hotfix` commit=`f2a9c3b-1`. @deploy-bot start canary replace.

deploy-bot: canary-replace | service=inference-runtime tag=release/kv-cache-v2-hotfix commit=f2a9c3b-1 replacing 10% canary (excluding pinned pool-a)

oncall-bot: deploy event: new canary containers rolling in (10%)

nina: Post-deploy: error rate back to baseline, latency normalized. Running smoke queries against hot paths.

tariq: smoke checks pass.

alex: OK to promote once the extension finishes. Keep pool-a pinned until full rollout schedule.

deploy-bot: canary-finish | service=inference-runtime result=success canary_end_ts=1755001299 promoted=false note='extension + hotfix applied, ready for promotion window'

alex: :thumbsup: I'll write a short release note and schedule promotion for off-peak using tag `release/kv-cache-v2-hotfix`.
